The Bashful Maid

Anonymous

 
(A Broadside Song with music, c. 1720)
M
UCH
 I love a charming Creature,

But the Flame with which I burn,

Is not for each tender Feature,

Nor her wit nor sprightly turn,

  But for her down a down down, down derry,
        5

  Hey down down a down derry down.

 

On the Grass I saw her Lying,

Straight I seized her tender waist,

On her Back she lay complying,

With her lovely Body placed,
        10

  Under my down a down down, down derry, &c.

 

But the Nymph being young and tender,

Could not bear the dreadful smart,

Still unwilling to surrender,

Called Mamma to take the part,
        15

  Of her down a down down, down derry, &c.

 

Out of breath Mamma came Running,

To prevent poor Nancy’s Fate,

But the Girl now grown more cunning,

Cried, Mamma you’re come too late,
        20

  For I am down a down down, down a,

  For I am down, a down derry down.
